content.title: About
content.content: Iced Cafe Mocha is a cold beverage made from espresso, milk, and chocolate syrup. The nonfat version uses skim milk, reducing calories while preserving the creamy coffee‑chocolate flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first “mocha” appeared in the early 1920s in the United States, combining coffee and chocolate.
Nonfat milk retains most of the protein but virtually no fat.
Cold coffee drinks are often served in glass cups with a straw to enhance the refreshing feeling.
Chocolate syrup can be dark or milk, changing the intensity of the flavor.
Coffee provides antioxidants, while chocolate adds flavonoids, together boosting heart health.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Both coffee and cocoa contain polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, increasing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Low‑calorie option
items.content: Skim milk lowers the drink’s calorie count compared with a traditional mocha.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Skim milk provides about 3 g of protein per 100 ml, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Caffeine and theobromine from chocolate can improve mood and reduce fatigue.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Chocolate syrup adds sugar, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Skim milk still contains lactose; those intolerant should consider plant‑based alternatives.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee can increase stomach acidity, which may be problematic for gastritis or reflux.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Iced Cafe Mocha cold over ice in a glass cup. Optionally top with nonfat whipped cream or a light dusting of cocoa powder for extra aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared drink refrigerated and consume within 24 hours. Store skim milk in its original sealed container at 1‑4 °C.
